```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(width = 120)
```

# Purpose

Each anatomical region is coded as a Yes/No severity variable from its regional
AIS (0-6). The cutoff used so far was AIS >= 3; this document looks at how
30-day mortality changes with the regional AIS level in each region, to help
decide whether AIS >= 3 or AIS >= 4 is a better definition of "severe".

All years present in the registry export are used (no split by year), and
patients are analysed region by region, without taking the injuries in the other
regions into account.

# 1. Data

The cohort is built with the preprocessing code of
`ultimate_validation_preprocessing.Rmd` (all code before the heading
"Preprocessed cohort" is executed).

```{r load-cohort}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

preprocessing_path <- file.path(
  "..", "ultimate_validation", "ultimate_validation_preprocessing.Rmd"
)
if (!file.exists(preprocessing_path)) {
  stop("Preprocessing document not found: ", preprocessing_path)
}
preprocessing_lines <- readLines(preprocessing_path, warn = FALSE)
cohort_end_line <- grep("^# Preprocessed cohort", preprocessing_lines)[1]
if (is.na(cohort_end_line)) {
  stop("The heading '# Preprocessed cohort' was not found.")
}

preprocessing_code_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
invisible(knitr::purl(
  text = preprocessing_lines[seq_len(cohort_end_line - 1L)],
  output = preprocessing_code_file,
  documentation = 0L,
  quiet = TRUE
))

preprocessing_env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
# The preprocessing code opens a table in RStudio; it is not needed here.
preprocessing_env$View <- function(...) invisible(NULL)
invisible(capture.output(
  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(
    source(preprocessing_code_file, local = preprocessing_env, echo = FALSE)
  ))
))
retrascore_cohort <- preprocessing_env$retrascore_cohort
if (is.null(retrascore_cohort)) {
  stop("The preprocessing code did not create 'retrascore_cohort'.")
}
```

```{r setup-data}
outcome_variable <- "mortality_30d"

# The same 11 non-anatomical candidates and 6 anatomical regions used in the
# variable-selection analysis.
non_anatomical <- c(
  "age_category",
  "preinjury_antithrombotic",
  "prehospital_intubation",
  "high_risk_mechanism",
  "pupils",
  "gcs_le_8",
  "hemodynamic_failure",
  "respiratory_failure",
  "coagulopathy_24h",
  "mechanical_ventilation",
  "massive_hemorrhage"
)

regions_df <- data.frame(
  key = c(
    "head", "upper_extremity", "thorax", "abdomen", "lower_extremity", "external"
  ),
  label = c(
    "Head", "Upper extremity", "Thorax", "Abdomen",
    "Lower extremity (incl. pelvis)", "External"
  ),
  ais_var = c(
    "head_ais", "upper_extremity_ais", "thorax_ais", "abdomen_ais",
    "lower_extremity_incl_pelvis_ais", "external_ais"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

needed_variables <- c(
  "row_id", outcome_variable, non_anatomical, regions_df$ais_var
)
if (!all(needed_variables %in% names(retrascore_cohort))) {
  stop(
    "Missing variables: ",
    paste(setdiff(needed_variables, names(retrascore_cohort)), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Derived severity variables for every region:
#   <key>_ge3, <key>_ge4 : Yes if regional AIS >= 3 (or >= 4), otherwise No
add_derived_columns <- function(data) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(regions_df))) {
    ais <- data[[regions_df$ais_var[i]]]
    for (cutoff in 3:4) {
      data[[paste0(regions_df$key[i], "_ge", cutoff)]] <- factor(
        ifelse(ais >= cutoff, "Yes", "No"),
        levels = c("No", "Yes")
      )
    }
  }
  data
}

# Complete cases for the outcome and all candidate predictors (same patients as
# in the variable-selection analysis), all years of the export.
cutoff_data <- retrascore_cohort[
  complete.cases(retrascore_cohort[, needed_variables, drop = FALSE]),
  needed_variables,
  drop = FALSE
]
cutoff_data <- add_derived_columns(droplevels(cutoff_data))
analysis_data <- cutoff_data
if (nrow(analysis_data) == 0L) {
  stop("The analysis sample is empty.")
}
y_outcome <- analysis_data[[outcome_variable]]

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Sample = "All years of the export",
    Patients = nrow(analysis_data),
    `Deaths within 30 days` = sum(y_outcome),
    `Mortality (%)` = round(100 * mean(y_outcome), 1),
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Analysis sample (complete cases)"
)

fmt_p <- function(p) format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
```

# 2. Mortality by AIS level in each region

If AIS 4 is a better cutoff than AIS 3, mortality should rise clearly between 3
and 4 and not between 2 and 3. The table shows deaths / patients (30-day
mortality) at each AIS level; the figure shows the same with 95% Wilson
confidence intervals (levels with fewer than 10 patients are not drawn). Dotted
lines mark the two candidate cutoffs.

```{r mortality-by-level}
mortality_by_level <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(regions_df)), function(i) {
  ais <- analysis_data[[regions_df$ais_var[i]]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(0:6, function(level) {
    in_level <- ais == level
    n <- sum(in_level)
    d <- sum(y_outcome[in_level])
    ci <- if (n > 0L) {
      suppressWarnings(prop.test(d, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int)
    } else {
      c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
    }
    data.frame(
      Region = regions_df$label[i],
      AIS = level,
      N = n,
      Deaths = d,
      Mortality = if (n > 0L) 100 * d / n else NA_real_,
      Lower = 100 * ci[1],
      Upper = 100 * ci[2],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}))

mortality_wide <- sapply(regions_df$label, function(region_label) {
  rows <- mortality_by_level[mortality_by_level$Region == region_label, ]
  ifelse(
    rows$N == 0L,
    "-",
    sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", rows$Deaths, rows$N, rows$Mortality)
  )
})
mortality_wide <- data.frame(`Regional AIS` = 0:6, mortality_wide, check.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
  mortality_wide,
  align = c("c", rep("r", nrow(regions_df))),
  caption = "30-day deaths / patients (mortality) by regional AIS level, all years"
)
```

```{r mortality-plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=6.5, fig.cap="30-day mortality by regional AIS level (all years, same y axis in all panels). Dotted lines: candidate cutoffs >= 3 (between 2 and 3) and >= 4 (between 3 and 4)."}
# Same y axis in every panel so that regions can be compared directly.
plotted_levels <- mortality_by_level[mortality_by_level$N >= 10L, , drop = FALSE]
common_ylim <- c(0, max(plotted_levels$Upper, na.rm = TRUE))

old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
for (region_label in regions_df$label) {
  rows <- mortality_by_level[
    mortality_by_level$Region == region_label & mortality_by_level$N >= 10L, ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (nrow(rows) == 0L) {
    next
  }
  plot(
    rows$AIS, rows$Mortality,
    type = "b", pch = 19,
    xlim = c(0, 6), ylim = common_ylim,
    xlab = "Regional AIS", ylab = "30-day mortality (%)",
    main = region_label
  )
  segments(rows$AIS, rows$Lower, rows$AIS, rows$Upper)
  abline(v = c(2.5, 3.5), lty = 3, col = "grey50")
}
par(old_par)
```

## Mortality by AIS level, alone or together with another region

Same figure, now with six lines per panel. In each panel (region) the patients
injured in that region (AIS 1-6) are split in these groups:

* **Only this region**: no other region has any injury (AIS 0 in the other five).
* **+ Head, + Upper extremity, + Thorax, + Abdomen, + Lower extremity,
  + External**: the other region named has an injury (AIS >= 1), whatever its
  severity and whatever happens in the remaining regions.

The "+" groups overlap: a patient with injuries in the region plus head and
thorax appears in both the "+ Head" and the "+ Thorax" lines. Colours are the
same for the same region in every panel. Levels with fewer than 10 patients in a
group are not drawn, the lines are shifted slightly horizontally so that the
confidence intervals do not overlap, and the y axis is the same in all panels.
AIS 0 is not drawn because the lines refer to patients injured in the region.

```{r mortality-by-level-group}
region_colours <- c(
  head = "#D55E00", upper_extremity = "#0072B2", thorax = "#009E73",
  abdomen = "#CC79A7", lower_extremity = "#E69F00", external = "#56B4E9"
)
ais_matrix <- as.matrix(analysis_data[, regions_df$ais_var])
region_injured <- ais_matrix > 0

# Groups of patients for region i: injured only there, or together with each of
# the other five regions.
build_groups <- function(i) {
  others <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(regions_df)), i)
  groups <- list(
    `Only this region` = rowSums(region_injured[, others, drop = FALSE]) == 0
  )
  for (j in others) {
    groups[[paste0("+ ", regions_df$label[j])]] <- region_injured[, j]
  }
  groups
}

mortality_by_level_group <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(regions_df)), function(i) {
  ais <- analysis_data[[regions_df$ais_var[i]]]
  groups <- build_groups(i)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(groups), function(group_name) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:6, function(level) {
      in_cell <- ais == level & groups[[group_name]]
      n <- sum(in_cell)
      d <- sum(y_outcome[in_cell])
      ci <- if (n > 0L) {
        suppressWarnings(prop.test(d, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int)
      } else {
        c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
      }
      data.frame(
        Region = regions_df$label[i],
        Group = group_name,
        AIS = level,
        N = n,
        Deaths = d,
        Mortality = if (n > 0L) 100 * d / n else NA_real_,
        Lower = 100 * ci[1],
        Upper = 100 * ci[2],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
  }))
}))

group_size_matrix <- t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(regions_df)), function(i) {
  ais <- analysis_data[[regions_df$ais_var[i]]]
  groups <- build_groups(i)
  sizes <- setNames(
    rep("-", 1 + nrow(regions_df)),
    c("Only this region", paste0("+ ", regions_df$label))
  )
  for (group_name in names(groups)) {
    sizes[group_name] <- as.character(sum(ais > 0 & groups[[group_name]]))
  }
  c(`Injured in this region` = as.character(sum(ais > 0)), sizes)
}))

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(Region = regions_df$label, group_size_matrix, check.names = FALSE),
  align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(group_size_matrix))),
  caption = "Patients injured in each region (AIS 1-6) in each group (the groups with '+' overlap; all years)"
)
```

```{r mortality-plot-group, fig.width=12, fig.height=7.5, fig.cap="30-day mortality by regional AIS level, with the injury alone or together with each other region (all years, same y axis in all panels). Dotted lines: candidate cutoffs >= 3 (between 2 and 3) and >= 4 (between 3 and 4)."}
plotted_group_levels <- mortality_by_level_group[mortality_by_level_group$N >= 10L, , drop = FALSE]
group_ylim <- c(0, max(plotted_group_levels$Upper, na.rm = TRUE))
x_offsets <- seq(-0.15, 0.15, length.out = 6)

old_par <- par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(regions_df))) {
  region_label <- regions_df$label[i]
  others <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(regions_df)), i)
  group_names <- c("Only this region", paste0("+ ", regions_df$label[others]))
  group_colours <- c("black", unname(region_colours[regions_df$key[others]]))

  plot(
    NA, xlim = c(0.5, 6.5), ylim = group_ylim, xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "Regional AIS", ylab = "30-day mortality (%)",
    main = region_label
  )
  axis(1, at = 1:6)
  abline(v = c(2.5, 3.5), lty = 3, col = "grey50")
  for (g in seq_along(group_names)) {
    rows <- mortality_by_level_group[
      mortality_by_level_group$Region == region_label &
        mortality_by_level_group$Group == group_names[g] &
        mortality_by_level_group$N >= 10L, ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(rows) == 0L) {
      next
    }
    x_values <- rows$AIS + x_offsets[g]
    lines(x_values, rows$Mortality, type = "b", pch = 19, cex = 0.7, col = group_colours[g])
    segments(x_values, rows$Lower, x_values, rows$Upper, col = group_colours[g])
  }
  legend(
    "topleft", legend = group_names, col = group_colours,
    pch = 19, lty = 1, bty = "n", cex = 0.7
  )
}
par(old_par)
```
